title: Koszul orthogonality detects extension from an open
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let j:U \to X be an open immersion, let V=Spec(A) be an affine open of X, and suppose X=U union V with U intersection V quasi-compact. Put Z=V minus U, choose f_1, ..., f_r in A with Z=V(f_1, ..., f_r), and let K be the bounded Koszul complex whose degree-q term is the q-th exterior power of A^r and whose differential is contraction with (f_1, ..., f_r), viewed as a perfect object of D(O_V) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex]. For every E in D_QCoh(O_V) [def-pc-derived-category], the following are equivalent: (i) the canonical map E \to R(U intersection V \to V)_*(E restricted to U intersection V) is an isomorphism; (ii) Hom(K[n],E)=0 for every integer n.
